schema: One row per challenged first-audit conclusion. verdict ∈ confirmed | corrected | rejected | unresolved | superseded (repo changed) | extended (confirmed + material addition). Evidence IDs: SC-nn = lead-auditor spot-check in evidence/second-audit-spotchecks.md; S2-SEC-nnn = evidence/security/findings-independent.json; BR verdicts = evidence/branches/branch-verdicts.json; RT = evidence/runtime/commands.md + results.json; WT = evidence/journeys/wiring-trace.md; S2-INT = evidence/integrations/*; EMU = evidence/runtime/emulator-run.md.

rows.claim_ref: BRANCHES_CODE.md: 11 codex/*, fix/*, 3 mia/*, 2 triage/*, claude/ci-repair-workflows = 18 DELETION CANDIDATES (squash-equivalent, no consumers)
rows.first_audit_evidence: cherry + aggregate patch-id + merge-tree identity + added-path checks (history-semantic-comparisons.json)
rows.independent_evidence: Branch agent: patch-id(squash^..squash) == patch-id(merge-base..tip) AND empty `git diff <tip> <squash> -- <touched paths>` for #28,#39,#42–#50,#65; all 0-ahead refs confirmed ancestors (`merge-base --is-ancestor`); name-consumer grep (commands.log); SC-29 for workflow bindings
rows.reasoning: Stronger test than the first audit's; zero hunks absent from main for every candidate; no executable consumers.
rows.consequence: 18 candidates stand. Preconditions unchanged: fresh tip check, force-with-lease, no mass delete.
rows.follow_up: Owner authorization; none of this was executed.

Update 2026-11-02: PR #72 CI run 41319340979 succeeded; PR #71's new tip failed only in Test Frontend with the same audit output (SC-54) — fix and diagnosis confirmed.

rows.claim_ref: ROADMAP M0 = WP-01/04/05/06 as one browser journey through canonical composition; 'fastest credible'
rows.independent_evidence: SC-31: main's own harness already covers ~70% of M0 (dev sign-in, migration, persona, API-seeded item, decision, reward, notifications, block, sign-out) with two substitutions (in-process dispatcher; API-seeded item). WT §5/§9: no consumer/jobs workload in any topology; consumerDomains off by default in Helm.
rows.reasoning: M0 is achievable in weeks, not months, because the harness exists; the cheapest first step is to repin consumer-ui.yml's BRANDME_DOMAIN_REFERENCE to the same checkout (WP-01) — that alone upgrades the composite evidence to same-revision evidence. WP-05 (real worker composition) is the hard part and should be sequenced before WP-04 is *finished*, since the decision/reward loop is the product value. 2026-11-02: WP-05 shown to be configuration-only (SC-61), which strengthens 'weeks, not months'.
rows.consequence: Order: WP-01 → WP-05 (compose jobs/ingress + enable consumerDomains) → WP-04 → WP-06; WP-02/03 in parallel with #72 merged first.
